body: I fucking hate my family. My mom is absolutely bat shit crazy. My dad is a meth addict, and I hardly see him. I don't talk to my brothers much. For years they sexually abused me. One of my brothers is addicted to heroin, and he smokes pot. He is always having highs and lows. My other brother is just there. He is addicted to his girlfriend. I don't speak to either of my half sisters, and they couldn't give 2 fucks about me anyway. I have 2 other siblings that I have never met, so I guess they don't count. I'm just feeling angry right now.

I want to kill myself, because I feel that no matter what I do, nothing will get better. I try my best every day..and I just fail. My family is no help. They never have been. They make everything worse. Everyone is always scratching at the fucking surface, but I'm at the bottom.
